subject: T4 accepted-cohort admission v1 stop-loss diagnosis

false_failures.reported_failure: candidate-cohort-manifest-t4-v1.json bytes drifted from first-add commit
false_failures.diagnosis: False. The v1 helper git(...) applies text .strip(), which removes the Git blob trailing newline before comparison to Path.read_text(...), while SHA-256 of raw current and git-show bytes is identical.
false_failures.required_v2_change: Use a byte-safe Git blob read such as subprocess.check_output without text=True or .strip(), then compare raw bytes.

false_failures.reported_failure: expected pending plan.md and metadata.json closeout changes were classified as admission instability
false_failures.diagnosis: False. The assigned admission task explicitly did not require a globally or scoped-clean tree; plan.md, metadata.json, and LAST-BATCH-STATUS.md are expected pending T4 closeout inputs. The v1 suffix filter also tested for a space before metadata.json/plan.md, but Git status paths contain a slash.
false_failures.required_v2_change: Report documentation dirt separately, without treating it as an admission failure; do not make clean working-tree state an admission invariant.

requirements: Preserve v1 as non-consumable historical stop-loss evidence and do not rerun or edit it.
Bind first-add lifecycle artifacts using byte-safe Git object comparisons.
Record T4 documentation dirt truthfully as pending closeout context rather than a failure condition.
Revalidate admission only against stable evidence inputs and retain no T8, product, implementation, or shipping authority beyond the gate result.
